description.html: The HabiStat Single Feeding Ledge is a practical feeder designed specifically for arboreal (tree-dwelling) reptiles that spend most of their time in elevated positions. It is made from quality black acrylic with one clear cup that offers full 360-degree visibility of the contents. Suction cups attach it securely to the glass walls of the terrarium with no need for glue or drilling, and repositioning it is quick and easy.

The clear cup detaches from the platform, which makes cleaning and refilling with food or water much easier. Its compact 80x60x80mm dimensions make it ideal for terrariums of all sizes without taking up too much space. The cup can hold fruit mash, insect powder, water or any other food your reptiles prefer.

This model is especially popular with crested gecko owners, since these geckos feed in elevated positions in the wild and rarely come down to the terrarium floor. By mounting the ledge at the right height, you simulate natural feeding behavior and reduce stress for the animal. It is also suitable for day geckos, anoles and other arboreal species that prefer to feed up high.
